'''Locux Hyen''' was a dangerous agent of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] who was driven mad by the Imperial experiments that turned him into a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]. He faced off against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] survivors of the bombardment of [[Edan Base]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]], along with [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Teles Jalahafi]].
